Leonardo Calzada spoke at the New Mexico Geographic Information Council (NMGIC) Fall Meeting 2026, *Beyond the Map: Scaling Geospatial Solutions*, held at the Doña Ana County Government Center in Las Cruces.

His talk, **"Landscape change in open moments: development, conservation, and local futures in the southern Yucatán,"** drew on the group's work combining remote sensing, spatial analysis and community-based research in Mexico's tropical forests.
